capabilities.name: Governed Topic Completeness Evidence Gate
capabilities.responsibility: Evaluate registered insurance topic definitions against governed evidence, preserve component-level missing, conflicting, unresolved, dependency, authority, version, and lineage conditions, and decide whether explanation is permitted without generating product facts or recommendations.
capabilities.authority_role: Topic-completeness and explanation-permission authority only; it consumes governed evidence resolver output and registered topic/profile definitions but does not retrieve evidence, infer product facts, resolve product identity, perform claim interpretation, compare products, assess suitability, rank, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Completeness evaluation must consume validated governed evidence resolver output and may not manufacture missing evidence or facts.

Required component conflicts, unresolved entity/version/lineage conditions, missing required components, and blocked dependencies must remain explicit and may block explanation according to the registered policy.
Topic profiles may strengthen required components but cannot weaken requirements already marked required by the registered generic topic definition.
Completeness and explanation-permission outcomes do not grant comparison, ranking, suitability, recommendation, or product-selection authority.
capabilities.notes: Census registration of the existing generic topic-completeness subsystem. Star Comprehensive pilot profiles are governed configuration that may strengthen generic topic requirements; they do not create independent decision or recommendation authority.
